claim: Atelier Moessmer Norbert Niederkofler is a 3-Michelin-Star restaurant with a Green Star located in Brunico, Trentino-Alto Adige.
quote: Atelier Moessmer Norbert Niederkofler, Brunico — Three MICHELIN Stars: Exceptional cuisine, worth a special journey. Green Star.

claim: The restaurant address is Via Walther von der Vogelweide 17, 39031 Brunico (BZ).
quote: Atelier Moessmer Norbert Niederkofler - Via Walther von der Vogelweide, 17, 39031 Brunico BZ, Italy

claim: Atelier Moessmer maintains a curated list of partner hotels and explicitly offers a complimentary round-trip transfer only to guests of Castel Maurn (5 km).
quote: Castel Maurn — A complimentary round-trip transfer is available to and from Atelier Moessmer, located just 5 km away.

claim: Castel Maurn is an 8-suite boutique castle hotel in San Lorenzo, first mentioned in 990 AD, with rooms €420–590/night including breakfast and full exclusive rental from €7,200.
quote: 8 suites accommodating a maximum of 20 guests… First mentioned in the year 990… €420–€590 per night for 2 persons including breakfast… Exclusive rental from €7,200.

claim: Castel Maurn was restored in 2020/2021, preserving 16th-century wood panelling and historic ceilings while adding modern amenities.
quote: The ageless castle underwent a meticulous restoration in 2020/2021, transforming it into a technically new house while preserving its historic charm.

claim: Schloss Sonnenburg (Castel Badia) is an 11th-century castle hotel in San Lorenzo di Sebato with 38 rooms, vaulted ceilings, a 3-level spa carved into the masonry, and a heated outdoor pool.
quote: Castel Badia, formerly known as Sonnenburg, is a medieval castle dating back to the 11th century, today transformed into an exclusive hotel.

claim: Schloss Sonnenburg has been named Historic Hotel of the Year and provides a winter shuttle to the Kronplatz ski area.
quote: Schloss Sonnenburg — Historisches Hotel des Jahres in St. Lorenzen / Pustertal / Südtirol

claim: Hotel POST Bruneck blends a 19th-century post-house heritage with contemporary city-hotel design, located in Brunico's old town.
quote: Hotel POST blends the charm of a historic post house with the style of a contemporary city hotel, located in the old town of Brunico.

claim: Emperor Franz Joseph of Austria stayed at Hotel Post in 1886; one suite bears his name and the property has been run by the Von Grebmer family for five generations.
quote: Emperor Franz Joseph of Austria stayed in the building in 1886, and one of the suites bears his name. The hotel has been run by the same family, the Von Grebmers, for five generations.

claim: Hotel Langgenhof is a 4-star family-run hotel in Stegen on the river-walk into Brunico centre, with stone-pine rooms, herb garden and coffee roastery; 3-night packages from €456 pp half-board.
quote: On the panoramic promenade along the river you can reach the town centre of Bruneck within only a few minutes' walk… Packages range from €456 for 3 nights to €1,292 for 7 nights per person.

claim: Niedermairhof is a historic farmhouse hotel in the Dietenheim hamlet of Brunico with 700-year-old walls and 8 individually designed suites (38–51 m²).
quote: 700 Jahre alte Mauern… 8 individuell gestaltete Suiten von 38 bis 51 m².

claim: Hotel Petrus is a 4-star family-run boutique hotel in Riscone, 500 m from the Plan de Corones gondola, with a 25-m heated pool (half outdoor) and the 3-toque Gault Millau restaurant Kaminstube.
quote: Just 1700 ft from the Plan de Corones ski lift… The new swimming pool (30°C) is 25 metres long, with half the pool outside… The restaurant Kaminstube has 3 toques from Gault Millau.

claim: Alpin Panorama Hotel Hubertus in Olang sits at 1,350 m and is famous for its 25-m cantilevered Sky Pool floating 12 m above the ground.
quote: At an altitude of about 1350 m… The Skypool stretches over 25 meters… floats 12 m above the ground, at its extreme edge.

claim: The Hotel Hubertus Sky Pool and Heaven & Hell wellness platform were designed by NOA Network of Architecture and cantilever 17 m over the slope with a glass-bottomed window.
quote: The pool has a width of 5 m, a length of 25 m and a depth of 1.30 m with over 17 m cantilevering… a glazed window on the bottom of the pool.

claim: Hotel Adler Suite in Niederdorf is a 400-year-old Pircher-family property featuring Hästens beds and the Adler Stube restaurant under chef Helene Markart.
quote: 400 Jahre Tradition… Hästens beds, described as 'the world's most expensive bed'… Adler Stube under chef Helene Markart.

claim: Forestis Dolomites is an adults-only luxury retreat on the Plose at Palmschoß above Bressanone, with Two Michelin Keys and a private villa option for up to 10 guests.
quote: Palmschoß 22… Adults-only boutique hotel… Two Michelin keys recognition… private villa accommodating up to 10 guests.

claim: Forestis sits at 1,800 m on the southern slope of Mount Plose, with structural glass-and-steel towers inspired by tree trunks designed by Armin Sader; carbon-neutral construction.
quote: Set at 1,800 metres on the southern slope of Mount Plose… three structural glass-and-steel towers inspired by the shape of tree trunks… for every tree felled during construction, two have since been planted.

claim: Aman Rosa Alpina reopened in San Cassiano (Alta Badia) with 51 rooms, suites and Chalet Zeno after a Jean-Michel Gathy redesign.
quote: 51 Rooms, Suites, Signature Suites and the private Chalet Zeno… Designed by Jean-Michel Gathy.

claim: Aman Rosa Alpina officially reopened in Alta Badia after a two-year renovation under Aman's ultra-luxury hospitality brand.
quote: Aman Rosa Alpina reopens in San Cassiano, Dolomites, with 51 luxurious rooms, fine dining, a wellness spa, Ski Butler service, and immersive seasonal experiences.

claim: San Lorenzo Mountain Lodge is a privately-rented 16th-century former Bishop-of-Brixen hunting lodge on 17 hectares, 15 minutes by car from Kronplatz, sleeping up to 10 with private helipad.
quote: 16th century hunting house of the Bishop of Brixen… surrounded by 17 hectares of trees and grass… 15-minute drive from the Kronplatz ski area… private helipad.

claim: San Cassiano to Bruneck is approximately 22 miles / a 34-minute drive.
quote: It takes approximately 34 minutes to drive from San Cassiano to Bruneck. The distance is 22 miles.

claim: Brunico's Centrale Taxi (Taxizentrale Bruneck) operates 24/7 at +39 0474 410042.
quote: You can order a taxi at the Taxizentrale Bruneck by phone +39 0474 410042 around the clock.

claim: Falkensteiner Hotel Kronplatz in Riscone is a 5-star Matteo Thun-designed Leading Hotels of the World property with a rooftop pool and seven-restaurant 7 Summit concept.
quote: Designed by renowned architect Matteo Thun… part of The Leading Hotels of The World collection… Seven-restaurant concept called '7 Summit' with open kitchen.
